about: Monster numbers. hp in hit points, times in seconds, distances in metres. hop follows the model's Jumping clip: it leaves the ground at liftOff and lands at land. takes: how much of each element's damage it takes (1 = normal). A slime that is hit gets angry for anger.time seconds: it chases the player (never further than anger.leash from home) and attacks; attack.cycle matches the Attacking clip and the blow lands at strikeAt if the player is within reach. Slimes that are not angry only threaten and never hurt. exp: what beating one gives.
